name: vibestack
description: vibestack — AI coding skills + a fast headless browser daemon. One repo, one install, the whole workflow.

scripts.vendor:xterm: mkdir -p extension/lib && cp node_modules/xterm/lib/xterm.js extension/lib/xterm.js && cp node_modules/xterm/css/xterm.css extension/lib/xterm.css && cp node_modules/xterm-addon-fit/lib/xterm-addon-fit.js extension/lib/xterm-addon-fit.js
scripts.build:diagram-render: cd lib/diagram-render && bun install && bun run scripts/build.ts
scripts.test:make-pdf: bun run build:make-pdf && bun test make-pdf/test/
